claims.claim: A client tool is defined with mode: client in the tool YAML
client.consent.required: if true, consent metadata is surfaced before execution
client.consent.message is the consent message shown to the user
OnClientTool(name, func(ctx, sdk.ClientToolRequest)(any, error)) runs immediately and the pipeline sends the result to the model
With no handler the pipeline suspends and returns pending calls via HasPendingClientTools/ClientTools (ToolName, ConsentMsg, CallID)
SendToolResult, RejectClientTool and Resume complete a deferred call
ChunkClientTool carries chunk.ClientTool.CallID and ResumeStream resumes the stream
A2A: client tool suspension surfaces as an input-required task with tool metadata on status message parts
A 1.0 caller sees TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED, ROLE_AGENT and SendMessage
The caller sends results via message/send with taskId; each result is a data part with metadata tool_call_id; the task returns to working
Metadata tool_result takes precedence over data
A message without taskId resumes the conversation under a new task and leaves the input-required one behind
Metadata rejected: reason rejects the call
SendToolResultMultimodal(ctx, callID, []types.ContentPart) returns rich content; the snippet reads tool.Arguments
A handler returning []types.ContentPart produces a multimodal result; other return values are serialized as JSON text
